explanation: It fires only at D2 when the agent chose a1 and a rare transition took it to S2: about 10 in the first ten trials of the episode, usually 8-9 later on, and sometimes much weaker (around 4, or even 0) late in the episode. It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and at every other D2 outcome, including a2 leading rarely to S1, whatever the rewards were.
